from collections import Counter,defaultdict
import numpy as np
def f2(I):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape
    bg=Counter(int(x) for x in I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[list(row) for row in I.tolist()]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i,j]!=bg: continue
            cheb=any(I[ny,nj]==bg for ny in range(max(0,i-1),min(H,i+2)) for nj in range(max(0,j-1),min(W,j+2)))
            adj=sum(1 for dy,dx in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)) if 0<=i+dy<H and 0<=j+dx<W and I[i+dy,j+dx]!=bg)
            out[i][j]= 1 if (cheb and adj==0) else 3
    return out
allok=True
for n in ['1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8']:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    p=f2(I); ok=p==O; allok&=ok
    mm=[(i,j,p[i][j],O[i][j]) for i in range(len(p)) for j in range(len(p[0])) if p[i][j]!=O[i][j]]
    print(n,ok,'mm',len(mm),mm[:10])

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bgc=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]!=bgc: continue
            # check pocket: all 4 orth neighbors bg or off-grid; flood fill via BFS through bg from border
            if i==0 or i==H-1 or j==0 or j==W-1: O[i][j]=3; continue
            for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                pass
            if all(0<=i+di<H and 0<=j+dj<W and I[i+di][j+dj]==bgc for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):
                O[i][j]=1
            else: O[i][j]=3
    return O

# Build feature table across demos: for each bg cell, features: 
#  - num orth neighbors obj, num cheb-1 obj neighbors
#  - inside any object bbox (min,max), row/col relative to bboxes
# Then see correlation with output value
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np
def feat_table(I,O):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    from collections import deque
    bgc=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]!=bgc and not seen[i][j]:
                col=I[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and not seen[na][nb] and I[na][nb]==col:
                            seen[na][nb]=True; q.append((na,nb))
                objs.append(cells)
    tab=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]!=bgc: continue
            oadj=sum(1 for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=i+dy<H and 0<=j+dx<W and I[i+dy,j+dx]!=bgc)
            adj1=sum(1 for di in range(-2,3) for dj in range(-2,3) if abs(di)+abs(dj)<=1 and (i+di,j+dj)==(0,0))
            cheb1=sum(1 for di in (-1,0,1) for dj in (-1,0,1) if (di,dj)!=(0,0) and 0<=i+di<H and 0<=j+dj<W and I[i+di,j+dj]!=bgc)
            oth=sum(1 for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=i+di<H and 0<=j+dj<W and I[i+di,j+dj]!=bgc)
            # in bbox of some object
            inbbox=any(min(a[0],b[0])<=i<=max(a[0],b[0]) and min(a[1],b[1])<=j<=max(a[1],b[1]) for a,b in [(None,None)]) # skip
            inb=[any(min(a[0],b[0])<=i<=max(a[0],b[0]) and min(a[1],b[1])<=j<=max(a[1],b[1]) for a,b in [])]
            inb=any(min(c[0] for c in obj)<=i<=max(c[0] for c in obj) and min(c[1] for c in obj)<=j<=max(c[1] for c in obj) for obj in objs)
            tab.append((oth,cheb1,inb,O[i][j]))
    return Counter(tab)
for n in range(1,9):
    print(n,feat_table(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']))

def feats(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    objs=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if grid[i][j]!=grid[0][0]]
    # assume uniform bg
    return H,W,objs
# Collect per-bg-cell features and label across demos
data=[]
for n in range(1,9):
    inp,out=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=objs_=feats(inp); H,W=None,None
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    ocells={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]!=inp[0][0]}
    bgcol=inp[0][0]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if (i,j) in ocells: continue
            lab=out[i][j]
            # features
            def dist(p,cheb=False):
                best=None
                for (oi,oj) in ocells:
                    d=abs(p[0]-oi)+abs(p[1]-oj) if cheb else max(abs(p[0]-oi),abs(p[1]-oj))
                    if best is None or d<best: best=d
                return best
            f=dict(bg=bgcol,man=dist((i,j)),cheb=dist((i,j),True),
                   up=min([dist((i-d,j,True)) for d in range(1,i+1)]+[99]) if False else 0,
                   border=(i==0 or i==H-1 or j==0 or j==W-1),
                   corner=(i in(0,H-1) and j in(0,W-1)),
                   man_up=dist(((i,j),( -1,0))), )
            data.append((lab,f))
from collections import defaultdict
tab=defaultdict(lambda:[0,0,0])
for lab,f in data:
    tab[(lab,f.get('man',0))][:]=None
# simpler: distribution of man dist per label
for lab in sorted(set(lab for lab,_ in data)):
    ds=sorted(set(f['man'] for lab,f in data if lab==lab_ if False for lab_ in [lab]))
    print(lab, Counter(f['man'] for lab_,f in data if lab_==lab))

# Systematic: for each demo, characterize 1-cells and 3-cells relative to objects. Compute, for each recolored bg cell, whether there's an object directly above/below/left/right in its column/row line of sight (unobstructed).
import os,re,json
from collections import deque,Counter,defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
info=[]
for n in range(1,9):
    inp,out=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); bgc=inp[0][0]
    info.append((n,H,W,bgc))
# feature: number of object cells in same row (left&right sides), same column (above&below), cheb/man dist, enc
rows=[]
for n in info:
    nn,H,W,bgc=n
    inp,out=G[f'Demo pair {nn} input'],G[f'Demo pair {nn} output']
    ocells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]!=bgc]
    def man(p): return min(abs(p[0]-o[0])+abs(p[1]-o[1]) for o in ocells)
    def cheb(p): return min(max(abs(p[0]-o[0]),abs(p[1]-o[1])) for o in ocells)
    # unobstructed line-of-sight counts (scanning outward from cell over bg until object or edge)
    def los(i,j,dr,dj):
        d=1
        while True:
            ni,nj=i+dr*d,j+dj*d
            if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W): return -1
            if inp[ni][nj]!=bgc: return d
            d+=1
    feats=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if inp[i][j]!=bgc: continue
            l,r,u,dn=los(i,j,-1,0),los(i,j,0,-1),los(i,j,-1,0) if False else (-1,-1),(-1,-1)
            u_=los(i,j,-1,0); dn_=los(i,j,1,0); le_=los(i,j,0,-1); ri_=los(i,j,0,1)
            f=(out[i][j],man((i,j)),cheb((i,j)),
               'u'+str(u_=='--') if False else (u_>0,'u'), (dn_>0,'d'), (le_>0,'l'), (ri_>0,'r'))
            rows.append(f)
keys=['label','man','cheb','up','down','left','right']
print(json.dumps([r[:7] for r in rows][:60]))

def analysis(n):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; outp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); bgc=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    o=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]!=bgc]
    rs=[a for a,b in o]; cs=[b for a,b in o]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    reach=set(); q=deque([(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in (0,W-1)]+[(i,j) for j in range(W) for i in (0,H-1)])
    while q:
        ci,cj=q.popleft()
        for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            ni,nj=ci+di,cj+dj
            if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W and inp[ni][nj]==bgc and (ni,nj) not in reach:
                reach.add((ni,nj)); q.append((ni,nj))
    print('--- demo',n,'HxW',H,W,'bbox',(r0,r1,c0,c1),'objects',len(o))
    kept=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==bgc and outp[i][j]==bgc)
    for k in kept:

                t+=1
            vis.append(blocked)
        dmin=min(abs(k[0]-a)+abs(k[1]-b) for a,b in o)
        print('   ',k,'enc',enc,'vis',vis,'dmin',dmin)

            f=dict(demo=i,r=r,c=c,
                   o=out[r][c],
                   # distances
                   ch=min(max(abs(a_-r),abs(b_-c)) for a_,b_ in objs),
                   mn=min(abs(a_-r)+abs(b_-c) for a_,b_ in objs),
                   # bbox membership
                   rb=min(a_ for a_,b_ in objs)<=r<=max(a_ for a_,b_ in objs),
                   cb=min(b_ for a_,b_ in objs)<=c<=max(b_ for a_,b_ in objs),
                   # count of objs in same row/col
                   nr=sum(1 for a_,b_ in objs if a_==r),
                   nc=sum(1 for a_,b_ in objs if b_==c),
                   nany=len(objs),
                   border=r in(0,H-1) or c in(0,W-1))
            feats[(i,r,c)]=f
keys=sorted(feats)
# decision tree style: find simple predicate over few features matching all
def score(pred):
    return sum(1 for k in keys if pred(feats[k])!=bool(feats[k]['o']==3))

for feat in ['ch','mn','rb','cb','nr','nc','nany','border']:

            if best is None or s<best[0]: best=(s,f,t,g,p)
